LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.ChariotLaser.Tra: Select a pawn or building. After a one-second charge, the beam tracks its target for up to ten seconds. It consumes 0.05% maximum energy every 6 ticks and deals 50 damage to a building every 6 ticks.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.ChariotLaser.Swe: Select two visible cells. The second must be within 10 cells of the first. After a one-second charge, the beam sweeps between them for four seconds and consumes 0.05% maximum energy every 6 ticks.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.ChariotLaser.Sto: Immediately end the current laser discharge.
LanguageData.MAP_MechanoidMechanitor.ChariotLaser.Dis: Cannot fire during an emergency landing.
